name: Hazel Harlow
author: Hardik Shah

sections.description:
Hazel Harlow is a powerful WordPress plugin that leverages AI to automatically update and refresh your existing content. Keep your posts relevant, up-to-date, and engaging with minimal effort.

Features

  • Content Updates: Automatically update older content with fresh information
  • Content Rewriting: Completely rewrite existing content while maintaining the original message
  • Bulk Operations: Update or rewrite multiple posts at once
  • Preview Changes: Review all AI-generated changes before applying them
  • Dashboard Analytics: Monitor content freshness and update history
  • Customizable Settings: Control how and when your content gets updated
  • Scheduled Updates: Set up automatic updates for stale content

Use Cases

  • Refresh outdated statistics and information
  • Update old posts with current trends and developments
  • Rewrite content while maintaining the original meaning
  • Keep your SEO optimized with fresh content
  • Save time on manual content updates

External Services

This plugin connects to external API services to provide AI-powered content updating and rewriting functionality. These services are essential for the core functionality of the plugin.

Hazel Harlow API Service

  • Service Purpose: The plugin connects to Hazel Harlow’s API service to process your content using AI algorithms for updating and rewriting posts, generating summaries, checking for dead links, and providing dashboard analytics.
  • API Endpoint: https://beta.hazelharlow.com/api/
  • Data Transmission: The following data is sent to the API:
    • Your API key for authentication
    • Page URL and content of posts being updated or rewritten
    • Site URL for dashboard analytics
    • Date ranges for analytics reporting
  • When Data is Sent: Data is transmitted when:
    • You preview content updates or rewrites
    • You apply content updates or rewrites to your posts
    • You access the dashboard analytics
  • Service Provider: This service is provided by Hazel Harlow
    • Terms of Service
    • Privacy Policy

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/hazel-harlow directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to Hazel Harlow > Settings to configure your API key and update preferences
  4. Start updating your content from the Hazel Harlow main page
sections.faq:
How does the AI know what to update?

Hazel Harlow analyzes your content to identify outdated information, facts, statistics, and references. It then researches current information to provide accurate updates.

Will the updates match my writing style?

Yes! The AI is designed to maintain your unique voice and writing style while updating the content.

Is there a limit to how many posts I can update?

The number of posts you can update depends on your subscription plan. Please visit hazelharlow.com for plan details.

What’s the difference between “Update” and “Rewrite”?

  • Update: Enhances your existing content by correcting outdated information and adding relevant details
  • Rewrite: Completely rewrites the content while maintaining the same topic and key points
